2026-09-12: real regression fix — user caught live: 'Guard pretty much dies from nothing... as it dies it stays on battlefield.' Root cause: the 2026-09-11 consolidation's `sequence:['onDies']` shortcut only ever runs the onDies TRIGGER'S EFFECTS (create the Hero token) — `harness.ts`'s `sequence` never performs the actual zone move (Battlefield -> Graveyard) that dying fundamentally is; `onDies`/`onLifeGained`-class triggers deliberately never auto-fire in this engine (see aerith-gainsborough's own header). Rewrote to a real, fully engine-piloted `runEngineScenarios()` (same real style as aerith-gainsborough): cast from hand -> real turn passage -> real BLOCKED combat against a real Coeurl (2/2, same card this session's Dion scenario already uses) -> real 2-for-2 lethal damage both ways -> a genuine `checkStateBasedActions` double destruction (both real fn:'destroy' lines, real controllers) -> onDies fires manually only after `guardReal.zone === 'Graveyard'` is confirmed true -> real fn:'createToken' for the Hero token. Verified in the regenerated trace.json: 'destroy' precedes 'trigger'(onDies) precedes 'createToken', in that real order — the Guard genuinely leaves the battlefield before its trigger fires. Also audited cloudbound-moogle's own `sequence:['onEnter']` for the same bug class per explicit request: NOT affected — `onEnter` doesn't require any additional real zone move beyond what the preceding real cast->enters lifecycle already provides (the card is already really on the battlefield when its ETB effect runs), unlike `onDies`, which needs a real LEAVE that nothing in the flat sequence ever performs. verify-synergy.mjs (scoped: 0 hard failures, same pre-existing soft-note classes every other engine-piloted card has; full pool 314: 0 hard failures). vitest 238/238. tsc --noEmit baseline unchanged (45).

2026-09-11, later: consolidated the 2 separate scenarios (plain cast/enter baseline + a separate trigger:'onDies' scenario) into ONE real scenario, per user's own live call on the Scenarios tab ('either one realistic scenario, or 0 scenarios'). No top-level `trigger` field now — harness.ts's own `selfZone` rule starts the card on the Stack, runs a real cast->resolve->enters lifecycle, THEN `sequence: ['onDies']` fires the death trigger after that (Scenario.sequence's own documented 'fires AFTER the normal cast->enters lifecycle' behavior) — so the single scenario now carries real fn:'cast'/fn:'enters' evidence for self-cast/self-enters AND real fn:'trigger'(onDies)/fn:'createToken' evidence for the token fact, no tradeoff needed (verify-synergy.mjs's own DEATH_TRIGGER_NAMES exemption for the self-dies fact doesn't care whether onDies fired via a top-level `trigger` field or mid-sequence, only that it fired at all). verify-synergy.mjs (scoped + full pool 314): 0 hard failures; vitest 238/238.
